parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
For new public instances or Enterprise instances, the instance has an ID value. You must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the invocation failed.
For legacy public instances, the instance has no ID value. You do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
